summary: Brady Corp filed an 8-K regarding entry into a $1.0 billion Credit Agreement to finance its pending acquisition of Honeywell International's Productivity Solutions and Services (PSS) business. The facility comprises a $500 million term loan and a $500 million revolving credit facility, maturing June 12, 2031. Brady replaced and terminated its prior credit agreement, exchanging $13 million in revolving loans. The revolver is capped at $300 million pre-closing and expands to $500 million post-closing. Joint lead arrangers include BMO Capital Markets, BofA Securities, CIBC, PNC, and Wells Fargo. Collateral and leverage-based pricing apply. Watch for PSS deal closing and integration risk.
